from pathlib import Path
import datetime,json
root=Path('mhd_llm/codex');out=root/'solver/thermo_cpu';meta=json.load(open(root/'inputs/metadata.json'));test=json.load(open(out/'tests/verification.json'))
readme='''Author: Codex-external_model
Optional controlled CPU speed/thermodynamic boundary extension

Build from any compatible source containing the project's Boundary::adjust:
  python scripts/build_thermo_cpu.py --source solver/cuda/hlld_cpu/mhd_solver_hlld.cpp --name mhd_solver_hlld_thermo
Run from codex directory, or supply the corresponding source path from elsewhere.
The builder writes solver/thermo_cpu/NAME.cpp,NAME.bin,NAME.diff andNAME_provenance.json. Relative quoted includes are preserved and resolved using-iquote with the original source directory; use the emitted command or builder to compile. Original sources and shared HLLD header remain unchanged.

The separate executable currently generated is mhd_solver_hlld_thermo.bin. Add these three lines to a selected run config to enable the control:
  boundary_speed_thermo_closure=1
  boundary_n_v2_cm3_kms2=1320464.1871439987
  boundary_T_over_v2_K_per_kms2=5.985098254241002
The coefficient file coefficients.cfg is a copyable snippet; the solver has no config-include directive. Values derive exactly from metadata n400*400^2,T400/400^2. Density coefficient uses1AU-normalized proton density, not the inner physical density; temperature coefficient applies at the inner radius. CSV speed already includes-50km/s, and no extra offset is implied by these lines.

Default flag0 retains independent primitive interpolation. Enabled flag1 reconstructs n1=C/v^2 and T=Dv^2 after interpolated speed receives boundary_speed_offset_kms, before density_scale/temperature_scale. Br and EMFs retain existing magnetic scaling/interpolation. Existing ConeBoundary applies afterwards, so CME density/temperature changes are not overwritten by the ambient closure. The flag accepts only0/1; finite positive coefficients and adjusted speed are required when enabled. Missing coefficients default0 and are rejected for flag1.

This is an explicit alternative empirical closure between samples, not a correction of measured density/temperature data. The actual maps do not observe these two fields. Vertices remain consistent when no extra speed offset is applied, up to printed CSV rounding. The old independently interpolated branch remains available as a control. The change does not alter the HLLD flux, GLM formulation, geometry, time integration, step_histogram.csv or counted hlld_fallbacks.json diagnostics.

Validation: scripts/verify_thermo_cpu.py, tests/verification.json and tests/unit_checks.json.8000compiled randomized actual/synthetic space-time queries with seams/clamps/offsets/rotation/scales/two coefficient choices agree to3.90e-16 scaled error;9invalid configurations rejected. Nonzero Br/EMFs unchanged. Actual Solver::initial confirms CME follows closure/scales. Full short8x4x8cases default-off andexplicit-off match all12base output files, excluding only statistics.json wall_seconds. Closure-on short case exits0. Production CPU source, original HLLD source/header, actual boundary CSV and metadata hashes remain unchanged before/after. No GPU work, large simulation, or production source edit was performed.

Scientific motivation and bounds are in external_model/boundary_interpolation_audit.txt and inner_mach_audit.txt. The compiled source, exact diff, binary hash and command are in mhd_solver_hlld_thermo_provenance.json.
'''
(out/'README.txt').write_text(readme)
p=root/'external_model/input_audit.txt';s=p.read_text();old='''The code's n∝v^-2 andTp∝v² correctly impose constant boundary proton thermal pressure
when p=2npkBTp. This follows a conventional ENLIL-style boundary closure. Density
angular structure is imposed by the speed law; it is not observed.''';new='''At CSV vertices, n∝v^-2 andTp∝v² impose constant boundary proton thermal pressure
when p=2npkBTp. The original solver interpolates v,n,T independently, so neither
nT nor nv² remains constant between vertices: the late source-band combined
midpoint/hourly99th-percentile ratios are1.28766/1.21344. An explicitly optional
query-time speed closure now exists under solver/thermo_cpu with tests and an
unchanged default-off branch. See boundary_interpolation_audit.txt for measured
biases and README.txt in that controlled solver directory. Density angular
structure is imposed by the speed law; it is not observed.''';assert old in s;s=s.replace(old,new);p.write_text(s)
p=root/'external_model/report.txt';s=p.read_text();s+='''\nQUERY-TIME THERMODYNAMIC CLOSURE AUDIT (2026-10-17 UTC)\nThe ambient n~v^-2,T~v^2 closure originally holds only at supplied CSV vertices.\nIndependent interpolation of v,n,T creates positive pressure and ram-flux biases\nwhere speed varies across contributing nodes. In the late-period comet-source\nlatitude band, combined2degree midpoint/hourly99th-percentile ratios are1.28766\nthermal/1.21344ram, with larger sampled extremes. These are boundary-prescription\nbiases, not observed solar compressions. See boundary_interpolation_audit.txt.\nA separately generated optional CPU control recomputes n/T from query speed after\nits offset and before scaling/CME application; builder/test/artifacts reside in\nscripts/build_thermo_cpu.py, scripts/verify_thermo_cpu.py andsolver/thermo_cpu/.\nDefault-off full short-case numerical outputs match the original, and the\noriginal source/header/input hashes remain unchanged. No production branch was\nreplaced by this audit.\n''';p.write_text(s)
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc);note=Path('mhd_llm/shared_notes')/f'codex_external_model_{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%MZ")}_thermo_cpu_control.txt';note.write_text('Author: Codex-external_model\nUTC: '+now.isoformat()+'\n\nSeparate optional CPU thermo boundary control built and tested. HLLD instance mhd_solver_hlld_thermo; parent production source/header and actualinputs remainhash-identical.\n\nFlagboundary_speed_thermo_closure defaults0. At1, requiredfinitepositive C=boundary_n_v2_cm3_kms2=1320464.1871439987,D=boundary_T_over_v2_K_per_kms2=5.985098254241002; recomputen1=C/v²,T=Dv² afterspeedoffset, thenexistingn/T/magnetic/Escales, thenexistingConeBoundary. Exactconfigsnippet solver/thermo_cpu/coefficients.cfg.\n\n8000compiledrandomactual/syntheticqueries pass3.90e-16 maxscalederror;9invalidconfigsrejected; nonzeroEMFs/Br unchanged; Solver::initial verifiesCMEafterclosure. Defaultoff/explicitoff12outputfiles matchoriginal shortcase excludingonlywall_seconds; closureonshortcasepasses. Tests+hashes in solver/thermo_cpu/tests/verification.json. Solveragent received exactAPI/diff for a separate optionalGPUderivative; thisagent performednoGPUwork.\n\nScientificdriver: current independentprimitiveinterp producespositivebetweenvertexpressure/ram bias; ambientconstantclaims applyonlyatverticesuntilthisalternativeisexplicitlyselected. Reports external_model/boundary_interpolation_audit.txt andinner_mach_audit.txt.\n');print(out/'README.txt');print(note)
